_doc: #1547 THE baseline of the runtime-data guard (cloud-android-runtime-data-guard.py): everything that is still baked into an APK, listed so a NEW baked JSON, gradle asset injection or BuildConfig base64 field fails CI. It only shrinks: migrate a dataset to the fleet data framework (libs:fleet-data-client, providers Cloud Store / Cloud Account), then drop its line here and lower the ceilings. json: path -> tier (1 personal -> Cloud Account personal/, 2 fleet/infra -> Cloud Account fleet/, 3 app defaults -> Cloud Store, 4 static reference -> Cloud Store pack or seed, mock = removed from release builds) and its target provider. The phase-2 order is in ticket #1547.

seed_allowlist._doc: Tier-4 STATIC reference data that may stay bundled as a SEED the runtime provider overrides: path or dir/ prefix -> reason (at least 20 characters). Empty in phase 1: the tier-4 files are baselined below and move to Cloud Store packs in phase 2.
seed_allowlist.ac_cloud-wiki/app/src/main/assets/chrono: #1830 the BOOTSTRAP of the runtime clone of the content repo: which repository and ref the app clones (#1867 Projects-Library-KG, whose generated wiki.json is the wiki's pages), its refresh modes and the CDN-to-APK rewrites the cloned pages need. It is read before any clone exists, so it cannot itself come from the clone or a served dataset; regen-chronos.py writes it from tools/chronos-pin.json, it holds no secret and no content.
seed_allowlist.ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/appstore/src/m: Tier-4 static reference (#1707): the apps retired from the fleet (package, where their function lives now). The Store must show an installed retired copy with Uninstall offline and on first run; the list holds a handful of rows and no secret, and a served pack may later override it.
seed_allowlist.ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/keyboard/src/m: Tier-4 static reference: the Unexpected keyboard theme's key and corner-glyph declaration (two layers). The theme must work offline on first use; a served pack may later override it.
seed_allowlist.ac_cloud-canvas/app/src/main/assets/boar: Not app data: #1787 the pinned offline copy of the Quickdraw whiteboard engine (Cloud Canvas > Draw > Board) and its pin manifest PIN.json. They are code and resources of a vendored web page, byte-pinned by PIN.json, and must be in the APK for the page to work with no network.
seed_allowlist.ac_cloud-canvas/app/src/main/assets/pain: Not app data: #1808 the pinned offline copy of three.js r128, its OrbitControls and the Inter font for Cloud Canvas > Painter, and their pin manifest PIN.json (tools/vendor-painter.py). They are code and resources of a vendored web page, byte-pinned by PIN.json, and must be in the APK for the page to work with no network.
seed_allowlist.ac_cloud-canvas/app/src/main/assets/soun: Tier-4 static reference bound to a bundled binary: #1809 the SoundFont engine's configuration for the GeneralUser GS bank shipped beside it in the same directory (the bank's identity, each Play instrument's General MIDI preset in that bank, the GM drum keys, the FluidSynth settings tuned on it). It changes only with the bank file and the engine build, which ship in the APK, so it ships with them; SoundFontTest checks every preset against the bank.
seed_allowlist.ac_cloud-tasks/app/src/main/assets/proje: Tier-4 static reference seed (#1757): the sample project Traveling (lodging, transport, events, deletable, flagged sample, seeded once) and the per-project calendar config (mode, lane order). It must be there on first run offline; the user deletes the sample and it is never given back.
seed_allowlist.ac_cloud-superintel/app/src/main/assets/: Cold-start seed (#1562): a byte copy of the served tier-3 dataset pages of Cloud SuperIntel (public page and row declarations, no secret). The pages must not be empty on first run or while Cloud Store has not served the dataset yet; the served dataset always overrides it and ColdStartSeedTest pins the copy to data/fleet so it cannot drift.

Cold-start seed (#1562): a byte copy of the served tier-3 dataset mcp of Cloud SuperIntel (public page and row declarations, no secret). The pages must not be empty on first run or while Cloud Store has not served the dataset yet; the served dataset always overrides it and ColdStartSeedTest pins the copy to data/fleet so it cannot drift.

Cold-start seed (#1562): a byte copy of the served tier-3 dataset plugins of Cloud SuperIntel (public page and row declarations, no secret). The pages must not be empty on first run or while Cloud Store has not served the dataset yet; the served dataset always overrides it and ColdStartSeedTest pins the copy to data/fleet so it cannot drift.
seed_allowlist.ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/appstore/src/m: Tier-4 static reference seed (#1791): the Store's own app list (one row per package, each with category, licence, Play Integrity tier, game dimension, source and icon) that every Search > Phone page filters. The pages must list apps offline and on first run, not stay empty while a runtime dataset is unserved (the bug it fixes); the list holds public app metadata and no secret, and the dispatchable icon check keeps its URLs live.
